# Feature: Floor switch — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #21 (Floor switch) from Switches and Doors before it is used in real levels. Effect: holds a door open while stood on. Unique: only held while the player personally stands there. Useful: poses stand-versus-leave dilemmas and starts sequences. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** holds a door open while stood on.

**So that** poses stand-versus-leave dilemmas and starts sequences.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Floor switch for the first time in its teaching room (mech-21-floor-switch-room). Teaching moment: First room: a floor switch in sight of its door, with the door too far to reach in one move. A player who steps on the switch, sees the door open, and steps off toward it arrives after it has closed, which teaches that the door is held rather than latched and that something has to stay on the plate. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: The linked door is open only while you, a bot or a block stands on the plate
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Step off and it closes on the next move
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Sprites show the plate pressed and the door state

## Edge Cases & Rules

- The linked door is open only while you, a bot or a block stands on the plate
- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Floor switch's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-21-floor-switch-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/switches-and-doors.yml mechanic #21.
